purpose: Define explicit interface/address, port and transport bindings for a named listener, including conflict detection and activation eligibility.

topics.name: Network Listener Binding
topics.purpose: Define explicit interface/address, port and transport bindings for a named listener, including conflict detection and activation eligibility.

semantics.listener_rule: Binding references one exact listener identity.
semantics.transport_rule: TCP/UDP/other transport is explicit where applicable.
semantics.wildcard_rule: Wildcard interfaces are explicit and never inferred.
semantics.activation_rule: Valid binding makes listener activation-eligible but not running.
semantics.authority_rule: Bound port grants no route or operation authority.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: port conflict resolved by last loaded listener

references.purpose: Bindings attach to exact listener identity.
